title: Elizondo confirms Hastings' UFOs and nukes reporting

tellings.quote: he's right he is legit he has his observations and and his conclusions are spoton I couldn't talk about it at the time when I was in the government uh but we everything he was reporting we saw yep it was absolutely correct

In 2021, Luis “Lue” Elizondo, the former director of a previously-secret UFO project at the Pentagon—the Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP)—confirmed in a podcast that his group had utilized the book as a resource when conducting its own research into UFO incursions at nuclear weapon sites. Said Elizondo, “There was a lot of information we didn’t have access to that, it turned out, Robert Hastings did … We were able to validate and substantiate exactly what he was saying.”

plain: The claim is that the Pentagon's own UFO office quietly confirmed years of reporting by Robert Hastings, a researcher who wrote the book UFOs and Nukes about UFOs appearing at American nuclear weapons sites. Luis Elizondo, the former head of AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, tells Michels that Hastings "is legit" and his conclusions are "spot on". He says he could not talk about it while in government, but "everything he was reporting we saw". Hastings himself records an earlier version in an article published on February 12, 2024. There he writes that in 2021 Elizondo said on a podcast that his group had used the book as a resource for its own research into UFO incursions at nuclear sites. He quotes Elizondo: "There was a lot of information we didn't have access to that, it turned out, Robert Hastings did ... We were able to validate and substantiate exactly what he was saying." If true, a Pentagon program found the same pattern of UFOs at nuclear bases that Hastings had gathered from witnesses.
